paragraphs.en: What's the matter with you? You don't look well today.
paragraphs.cn: 你怎么了？你今天看起来气色不太好。

paragraphs.en: I have a headache and a sore throat. I feel terrible.
paragraphs.cn: 我头痛而且嗓子痛。我感觉糟透了。

paragraphs.en: You should drink more water and get some rest.
paragraphs.cn: 你应该多喝水并好好休息。

paragraphs.en: Maybe you have a fever. Let me take your temperature.
paragraphs.cn: 也许你发烧了。让我给你量一下体温。

paragraphs.en: Thank you, doctor. I will take the medicine and stay in bed.
paragraphs.cn: 谢谢你，医生。我会吃药并卧床休息。

paragraphs.en: Don't worry. You will get better soon. Take care of yourself.
paragraphs.cn: 别担心。你很快就会好起来的。照顾好自己。
